parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem:
A floating sphere is attached by a cable to the bottom of a river, as shown in Fig. 1.2.

{{figure:figure_1_2.png}}

The sphere is in equilibrium, with the cable at an angle of 75° to the horizontal. Assume that the force on the sphere due to the water flow is in the horizontal direction.

The radius of the sphere is 23 cm. The sphere is solid and is made from a material of density 82 kg m$^{-3}$.
parts.text: Show that the weight of the sphere is $41\,\mathrm{N}$.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
The tension in the cable is $290\,\mathrm{N}$.
Determine the upthrust acting on the sphere.

(N)

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: Explain the origin of the upthrust acting on the sphere.
